# Browser dependencies

Vendored from the official `gsap@3.15.0` npm package on 2026-10-19:

- `gsap.min.js` and its source map
- `ScrollTrigger.min.js` and its source map

Copyright headers are preserved. GSAP uses its own [Standard License](https://gsap.com/standard-license/), not this repository's MIT license. Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap/v/3.15.0

Animation implementation follows the official [GSAP skills](https://github.com/greensock/gsap-skills), specifically core, timeline, ScrollTrigger, and performance guidance. These instructions were read for this change; they are not installed globally or shipped with the site.

Manrope is self-hosted in `../assets/fonts/` under the accompanying SIL Open Font License. Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/manrope
